caption:
Can one line on your payslip cut your tax by ₹17,472?

In the new tax regime, your employer's NPS contribution is deductible up to 14% of basic + DA, for private and government employees.
Illustrative: ₹50k basic/month → up to ₹84,000 a year → at the 20% slab plus 4% cess, ≈ ₹17,472 less tax.
It usually comes out of your CTC, so take-home pay falls and the money stays invested for retirement. Total employer PF + NPS + superannuation is capped at ₹7.5 lakh a year.
